name: Black-Glazed Teabowl with Incised Characters (供御) for “Imperial Tribute”
summary: Teabowls with incised characters are rare. The characters 供御 (gongyu; “imperial tribute”) incised on the base of this bowl suggest that it was local annual tribute ware presented to the court. The abrasions on its rim indicate the cup was originally mounted with a metal ring that has been removed. T
